fine.note: Liquidated damages match AtliQ standard of 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the milestone fee, exclude client-caused delays, and serve as the sole and exclusive remedy.
Payment terms match the standard 30-day window from receipt of invoice.
Limitation of liability matches standard with a mutual cap equal to total fees paid or payable, with standard carve-outs.
Indemnity provisions are mutual for breach and negligence, and IP infringement indemnity is limited to AtliQ deliverables.
IP terms correctly retain AtliQ's pre-existing IP and assign custom deliverables to the client only upon payment in full.
Termination for convenience provides 30 days notice and guarantees payment for work performed and pro-rata milestone work in progress.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual, standard exceptions apply, and survival is limited to 3 years.
Data protection provisions comply with applicable data protection laws without imposing uncapped liability or missing sub-processor consent requirements.
Warranties are limited to professional performance and a standard 30-day post-pilot correction window.
Governing law and dispute resolution (Indian law, arbitration in Mumbai) match the standard for AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd.
